findings.title: SSE rule release pages were initially archived without their operative attachments
findings.evidence: S09 and S14 initially pointed to release HTML pages; operative DOCX attachments and S09 deferred-provisions attachment were subsequently archived and checksummed.
findings.repair: Added sse_trading_rules_2026.docx, sse_trading_rules_2026_deferred.docx and sse_margin_rules_2023.docx; updated registry and claim audit.
findings.verification: Local source paths exist; S09 3.1.4–3.1.5 and S14 detailed-rule conditions were read from the archived attachments.

findings.title: Historical CSRC margin page risked being labelled as a current operative rule
findings.repair: Reclassified S08 as historical educational/regulatory context only; current financing-rule statements use S14 operative detailed rules.
findings.verification: Registry, source appendix and main text distinguish the historical source.

findings.title: Public REIT source labels initially omitted operative attachments and misidentified the issuance/listing guide
findings.evidence: S10 and S11 initially retained only release pages in the registry; the S11 operative attachment is titled Shanghai Stock Exchange Guidelines No. 1 for Publicly Offered Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) — Issuance and Listing Administration (June 2026 revision), not an infrastructure-REIT guide.
findings.repair: Archived and checksummed both operative DOCX attachments; corrected the registry, claim audit, China chapter and source appendix to use public-real-estate-REIT issuance/listing wording and product-specific scope.
findings.verification: Local operative attachments exist, registry title/path/hash reconcile, and reader-facing text requires underlying-asset, rule and product-document confirmation.

findings.title: Manager process descriptions were at risk of being read as causal return attribution
findings.evidence: The initial matrix and strategy packet used causal language and lacked field-level source locators; Bain's source supports a manager-described operating-transformation approach, not a fixed menu of operating levers.
findings.repair: Added documented-fact locators, evidence classes and analytical-inference fields to every manager row; removed causal outcome wording and narrowed the Bain row.
findings.verification: The packet, matrix source note, claim audit and case verifier now distinguish official structure/self-description from analytical translation and explicitly reject causal attribution.
